title: Silas and the House
author: Ada Sandoval
blurb: Lior Ravensworth, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
